evidence: Rewrites core validation files (src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, src/node/blockstorage.cpp) to eliminate concurrent chainstates and background validation.
rationale: Resolving the architectural complexity of concurrent chainstates addresses a major recurring maintenance and correctness burden across validation paths. As the PR notes, 'Maintaining concurrent chainstates adds pervasive architectural complexity across validation, cache sizing, database lifecycles, pruning bounds' and introduces 'elevated cognitive load and subtle synchronization edge cases across core validation paths'.
